incidentbot: :rotating_light: PD alert fired: embeddings-queue-high-backlog (P2) — auto-page to oncall
sanjay: On it. Joining the bridge now. Any initial customer-facing errors? :thinking_face:
emily: I see increased queue latency in eu-west and many 429s from the embedder. Looks like KV cache misses spiked.
maria: Confirmed for a couple customers — support reported delayed responses. ETA on mitigation?
incidentbot: PagerDuty: Alert details: service embeddings-service, trigger rate 120/min, latency p95 4.2s, queue length 18k. Recent deploy: none in last 30m.
sanjay: Quick check: running `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep embedder` — CPU not saturated. Suspect KV eviction storm. Can someone run `redis-cli INFO` on cache-prod?
emily: Running now, attaching logs snippet:
```
# redis INFO keyspace
# Keyspace
db0:keys=120000,expires=0,avg_ttl=0
# Stats
evicted_keys: 4823
hit: 12456
miss: 34780
```
emily: eviction count is high — misses >> hits. That explains spikes.
maria: For customer comms: Recommend short PSA: "We are investigating increased latency for embeddings in EU; working on cache stabilization."
sanjay: I will take ownership. Adding myself as PD responder: sanjay -> ack. :+1:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: sanjay acknowledged the alert and is the assigned responder.
emily: Immediate mitigation: flip embedder to read-through cache bypass for hot prefixes. Patch command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/services/embedder/cache?action=bypass -d '{"prefixes": ["cust:hot:"]}'
```
emily: Doing a gradual bypass on eu-west A now.
sanjay: After A looks good, roll to B/C. Also enabling temporary rate-limiter to shed 20% of non-essential traffic.
maria: I'll post the PSA in status and ping support. Draft: "Users in EU may see delayed embeddings. We’re mitigating and will update in 15m."
incidentbot: Deploybot: cache-bypass-v1 rolled to eu-west-A (ok)
emily: eu-west-A shows queue dropping from 18k -> 6k, p95 down to 1.8s. Proceeding to B.
sanjay: Good. Reminder to collect traces for postmortem: include KV eviction metric, recent config pushes, and client retry spikes.
emily: B rolled, C rolling. Observability shows aggregated queue length 2.4k now.
maria: Support updated customers and linked to incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8791
sanjay: Handoff plan: I'll own until queue < 500 and no customer error reports for 10m, then hand to emily for postmortem and follow-up. Ping me when stable.
emily: Acknowledged. I'll prep a postmortem checklist.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: sanjay marked the incident as acknowledged at 1768901240.
maria: Support confirms customer-facing errors dropping.
sanjay: Marking mitigation success checklist items.

sanjay: Queue consistently < 400 for 12m, no new customer errors. Reassigning ownership to emily for RCA and follow-up.
emily: Taking over. Will open RCA doc within 1h and schedule postmortem write-up.

maria: Thanks team. Sending final customer update then closing the page.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: alert resolved by sanjay at 1768901354. Incident closed.
